The position leads overnight security Officers, conducts patrols, monitors alarms, and enforces park policies. A Texas Level 2 Security License and a high school diploma are required, along with the ability to lift up to 75 lbs

jobs.description:

Minimum requirements include Level III Armed Certification for Texas, a high school diploma, and willingness to undergo background checks and drug testing. This is a full-time on-site role with a weekend schedule.

jobs.title: Night Security Guard — San Antonio Senior Living
jobs.description:
The Army Residence Community in San Antonio, Texas, is seeking a Security Guard for the overnight shift from 11 PM to 7 AM. The role supports our nonprofit Life Plan community serving retired military families, with emphasis on safety, vigilance, and courtesy toward residents.

Applicants should have prior security experience, be willing to cover other shifts as needed, and pass a pre-employment physical, drug screen, and background check.
